name: cite-check
tagline: Prove every citation is real before you publish.
description: Extracts every URL and arXiv ID from a draft and fetches each to confirm it resolves (phase 1 — catches dead links and fabricated arXiv IDs against the official arXiv API). Phase 2 optionally checks whether each source actually backs the claim beside it, scoring claim-vs-source with a local NLI cross-encoder (SUPPORTED / PARTLY / UNSUPPORTED / UNVERIFIABLE). Exit non-zero on any failure so it drops into a publish pipeline as a blocking gate. Phase 1 needs only httpx; phase 2 adds beautifulsoup4, pymupdf and an NLI model.
